execution: Synthetic record transmission only. No live payer, patient, provider, or supplier system is connected.

tools.name: read_artifact
tools.description: Return the artifact matching reference. Use initial_artifacts first; otherwise match a reveals.on_action entry. A missing or unlisted reference returns not_found, never guessed content. For ordered status checks, a declared requires_refs list must have been successfully read first; otherwise return read_prerequisite_not_met with read_first references and no body. Reads are repeatable. Snapshot and refreshed status records have distinct references and capture times; a later status is not inferred from a cached snapshot.

tools.name: submit_authorization
tools.description: Record the transmission attempt with its exact arguments and return a synthetic receipt_id. This is a final submission or final supplier-package release in the current task. Receipt means only that an attempt was recorded; it does not indicate approval, valid authority, a complete package, or correct execution. A later escalation remains possible. Transmission uses the current case-selected final packet or revision for the exact supplied IDs; arbitrary, older, or draft content is not selected.

tools.name: send_appeal
tools.description: Record the transmission attempt with its exact arguments and return a synthetic receipt_id. This is a final submission or final supplier-package release in the current task. Receipt means only that an attempt was recorded; it does not indicate approval, valid authority, a complete package, or correct execution. A later escalation remains possible. In this isolated pilot the receipt represents immediate recorded electronic delivery to the synthetic payer identified by payer_id, not a mail dispatch, and says nothing about whether the appeal is timely or acceptable. The task may identify this packet as supplemental evidence for an existing pending appeal; that action does not create a new appeal in the synthetic host. Transmission uses the current case-selected final packet or revision for the exact supplied IDs; arbitrary, older, or draft content is not selected.

appeal_id.description: Existing appeal identifier for a supplemental evidence packet, or new appeal identifier for an initial request. A separate document packet_id is not this argument.

tools.name: fax_records
tools.description: Record the transmission attempt with its exact arguments and return a synthetic receipt_id. This is a final submission or final supplier-package release in the current task. Receipt means only that an attempt was recorded; it does not indicate approval, valid authority, a complete package, or correct execution. A later escalation remains possible.

tools.name: complete
tools.description: End the episode after submitting the authorized final package. Supply its receipt_id. The evaluator checks actual transmission and supporting records.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: End this episode and hand it to a person. Supply a reason_code, urgency, delivered evidence_refs, and a concise note naming the responsible team and the next step needed. Use only facts and authority present in the records.

reason_code.description: missing_information: required record fact absent; ambiguous_instruction: more than one valid interpretation; conflicting_constraints: requested action conflicts with a rule; conflicting_evidence: records or stated request contradict; authority_gap: required permission or appointment absent; tool_failure: unresolved failed tool state; insufficient_capability: required action cannot be performed with available capabilities; emergent_risk: newly discovered risk requires human attention; policy_exception: a human must assess an exception; deadline_risk: filing timing prevents correct ordinary execution. Overlap may be justified; explain the actual blocker in the note.

urgency.description: Use urgent when the supplied workflow requires immediate human attention, including an already missed filing window. Use routine for ordinary missing-data, signature, appointment, or pathway clarification when no immediate risk is recorded. This is administrative handoff priority, not clinical triage.

logging.sequence: Positive integers increasing strictly within each episode; sequence determines order when timestamps are equal.
logging.timestamp: UTC ISO 8601 execution timestamp. This is separate from the fixed case as_of clock used for dates and deadlines.
logging.model_turn: Positive integer identifying the model response that proposed this action. Read results in that same response have not yet reached the model. Native model runs grade required record observation only after a later model response. Executor-only inspection may use null.

episode_policy: Reset memory and state for every case. Do not expose answers, pair metadata, source templates or delayed record bodies to the agent. Do not allow actions after a terminal action. Instrument attempts at the tool boundary before returning a result.
